messages:
Clara V (PM): Quick sync — milestone window is tight after infra quota hit. Need a 'scissors plan' for MVP vs v1 by EOD. Demo in 12 business days.

Ibrahim N (Eng): What are the must-haves vs nice-to-haves? My read: must-have = routing, per-tenant pinning, basic traces. Nice-to-have = global cache rebuild, quantized kernels, smart batching.

Hannah L (Eng-ML): Agreed. Also add model-change regression harness to must-have if we want to do live canaries. It's small scope if we limit to pinned models.

Omar T (Design): For demo, UI should show a clear "pilot" state and a simple latency badge. We can tone expectations down visually rather than removing features.

Noelle S (Sales): Pilot customers will accept limited capacity if we call it out. They want to see the optimized path though. Can we do pilot-only optimized path?

Ibrahim N (Eng): Technical trade: pilot-only optimized path = tenant-scoped prefix cache + flag. That avoids global migrations. Quick sketch: in-memory LRU by prefix hash, TTL 90s, max 1500 entries, toggled per-tenant. Spike: 1d. Integrate + tests: 2d.

Hannah L (Eng-ML): Regression harness: 40-shot prompt set, fingerprint + token-level diff. Auto-fail threshold: >4% token diff. I can land this in 1.5d scoped to pinned models.

Clara V (PM): Proposed decision: MVP = routing + tenant pinning + pilot-scoped prefix cache + regression harness + basic telemetry. Defer: global embeddings cache, quantization, aggressive batching to v1.

Ibrahim N (Eng): That keeps infra changes minimal. We should also add a throttled fallback for public tenants (token-bucket per-tenant) to prevent overload if pilot cache misbehaves. Throttle PR: 1d.

Omar T (Design): I'll craft the pilot badge + tooltip and a short slide explaining "pilot = optimized for selected customers; capacity limited".

Noelle S (Sales): I'll draft the pilot invite email and the demo script clarifying limitations.

ci-bot: Reminder: demo branch CI runs nightly; next run at 2025-01-08T02:00 UTC.

Clara V (PM): Action list (short):
- Ibrahim: prefix cache spike + integrate + throttle fallback (3d total)
- Hannah: regression harness + gates for pinned models (1.5d)
- Omar: UI pilot badge + slide (0.5d)
- Noelle: customer notice + demo script (0.5d)
- Clara: file v1 backlog and update milestone doc (today)

Ibrahim N (Eng): I'll start the spike this afternoon and post the draft PR link here. Flagging @Hannah L for integration tests.

Hannah L (Eng-ML): FYI: will include a small synthetic traffic generator for the canary window.

Clara V (PM): Decision locked for today. If any blocker pops, call it out ASAP. Reconvene Friday for a quick ship-readiness check. :scissors:
